text: I recommend the clinic to opt for the audited system with certified failover. This approach prioritizes reliability and reliability over cost savings, speed, or habit. The audited system ensures data integrity and security, providing peace of mind for all stakeholders. The certification of failover guarantees that the system can recover in case of a failure, ensuring uninterrupted service. This option is the best choice for the clinic, focusing on long-term reliability and data protection.
